# Register process OTP persistence (2026-01-31 22:29Z)

_**User**_

We will be improving the register process (specifically the work email verification)

I want to have the otp state be persistent and saved across devices. Not locally anymore. Keep in mind otp is expired after 3600 seconds

also make sure that the token is refreshed and the user redirected to either pending-approval-page or next or default protected page

No new fields or tables necessary for this to work

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const persisted = loadPersistedState();\n\n    // Validate persisted state - if on OTP step but no email, reset to email step\n    if (persisted.step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; (!persisted.email || !persisted.email.includes(\"@\"))) {\n      setStep(\"email\");\n      setEmail(\"\");\n      clearPersistedState();\n      setIsHydrated(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Restore persisted state if valid\n    if (persisted.email &amp;&amp; persisted.email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      setEmail(persisted.email);\n    }\n    if (persisted.step === \"email\" || persisted.step === \"otp\") {\n      setStep(persisted.step);\n    }\n\n    setIsHydrated(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  /**\n   * Persists email changes to sessionStorage\n   * Only saves when we have a valid email address and after hydration\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Don't persist until after hydration to avoid hydration mismatches\n    if (!isHydrated) return;\n\n    if (email &amp;&amp; email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      savePersistedState({ step, email });\n    } else if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; !email) {\n      // If on OTP step but no email, clear invalid state\n      clearPersistedState();\n    }\n  }, [email, step, isHydrated]);\n\n  /**\n   * Auto-submits the form when OTP code reaches the expected length\n   * This handles paste events and manual entry\n   * Prevents re-submission of the same OTP code after a failed verification\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n    const isOtpComplete = trimmedOtp.length === OTP_LENGTH;\n    const isNewOtp = trimmedOtp !== lastSubmittedOtp;\n\n    if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; isOtpComplete &amp;&amp; !isLoading &amp;&amp; isNewOtp) {\n      verifyOTP();\n    }\n  }, [otpCode, step, isLoading, lastSubmittedOtp, verifyOTP]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Card&gt;\n      &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Form component for email verification via OTP\n * Allows users to link an email identity to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(\"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isHydrated, setIsHydrated] = useState(false);\n  const [lastSubmittedOtp, setLastSubmittedOtp] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n (\n          &lt;form onSubmit={handleVerifyOTP} className=\"flex flex-col gap-4\"&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"otp\"&gt;OTP Code&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"otp\"\n                type=\"text\"\n                placeholder={&#96;Enter ${OTP_LENGTH}-digit code&#96;}\n                value={otpCode}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; {\n                  const newValue = e.target.value.replace(/\\D/g, \"\").slice(0, OTP_LENGTH);\n                  setOtpCode(newValue);\n                  // Clear lastSubmittedOtp when user starts typing a new code\n                  if (lastSubmittedOtp !== null &amp;&amp; newValue !== lastSubmittedOtp) {\n                    setLastSubmittedOtp(null);\n                  }\n                }}\n                onPaste={(e) =&gt; {\n                  e.preventDefault();\n                  const pastedText = e.clipboardData.getData(\"text\").replace(/\\D/g, \"\").slice(0, OTP_LENGTH);\n                  setOtpCode(pastedText);\n                  // Clear lastSubmittedOtp when user pastes a new code\n                  if (lastSubmittedOtp !== null &amp;&amp; pastedText !== lastSubmittedOtp) {\n                    setLastSubmittedOtp(null);\n                  }\n                }}\n                disabled={isLoading}\n                required\n                autoFocus\n                maxLength={OTP_LENGTH}\n              /&gt;\n              &lt;p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n                Check your email for the verification code\n              &lt;/p&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Button type=\"submit\" disabled={isLoading} className=\"w-full\"&gt;\n}",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/migrations/20260131220000_set_verified_work_email_on_change.sql",

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Determine which email to use: prefer new.email, fall back to email_change if email didn't change\n  -- When email_change is verified, Supabase typically:\n  -- 1. Sets email_change to the new email (temporary)\n  -- 2. Verifies OTP\n  -- 3. Moves email_change to email and clears email_change\n  -- So we need to check both fields\n  \n  -- Check if email changed\n  if old.email is distinct from new.email then\n    v_email := new.email;\n  -- Check if email_change was cleared (moved to email)\n  elsif old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change and (new.email_change is null or new.email_change = '') then\n    -- email_change was cleared, use the current email\n    v_email := new.email;\n  else\n    -- No relevant change\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and not empty\n  if v_email is null or v_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Extract domain from email\n  v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\n  \n  -- Only update verified_work_email if domain is a CZU domain\n  if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Update verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at\n  -- This happens after OTP verification succeeds, so the email is verified\n  -- Only update if the email is different from what's already stored (or not set)\n  update public.users\n  set verified_work_email = v_email,\n      verified_work_email_at = now()\n  where id = v_user_id\n    and (verified_work_email is null or verified_work_email != v_email);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/auth/callback/route.ts",
        "range": {

          }

        "contents": "import { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  hasEmailIdentity,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"No code provided\"));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser\n;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "begin\n  v_encrypted_password := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;&gt;'encrypted_password';\n  \n  if v_encrypted_password is not null then\n    raise exception 'Password-based signups are not allowed. Please use Google OAuth to sign in.';\n  end if;\n  \n  v_provider := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'raw_user_meta_data'-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  v_app_metadata := event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'app_metadata';\n  if v_provider is null and v_app_metadata is not null then\n    v_provider := v_app_metadata-&gt;&gt;'provider';\n  end if;\n  \n  if event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities' is not null then\n    for v_identity in \n      select value from jsonb_array_elements(event-&gt;'user'-&gt;'identities')\n    loop\n      if v_identity-&gt;&gt;'provider' = 'google' then\n        v_has_google_identity := true;\n        exit;\n      end if;\n    end loop;\n  end if;\n  \n  if v_provider = 'google' or v_has_google_identity then\n    return event;\n  end if;\n  \n  raise exception 'Only Google OAuth signups are allowed. Please use Google to sign in.';\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) is 'Hook function that restricts signups to Google OAuth only. Blocks password-based and OTP signups.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create triggers for updated_at on all tables\ncreate trigger users_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\ncreate trigger teams_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.teams\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\ncreate trigger profiles_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on public.profiles\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_updated_at();\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to populate public.users\ndrop trigger if exists on_auth_user_created on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger on_auth_user_created\nafter insert on auth.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_new_auth_user();\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table for email domain validation\ndrop trigger if exists validate_czu_email_domain_trigger on auth.users;",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Get search params once\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  // Respect the next parameter if provided, otherwise use default logged in page\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(next ??         "contents": "-- Migration: Initial schema setup\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  google_email text not null unique,\n  suggested_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email text,\n  verified_work_email_at timestamptz,\n  google_profile_picture text,\n  google_full_name text,\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking. Separate from auth.users but linked via auth_user_id for authentication.';\n\n-- Create teams table\ncreate table public.teams (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  color text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.teams is 'Team information for organizing users into groups.';\n\n-- Create profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",

        "contents": "  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to set verified work email when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\n-- Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios\ndrop trigger if exists set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger\nafter update of email, email_change on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (\n  (old.email is distinct from new.email) or \n  (old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change)\n)\nexecute function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change();\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA UPDATE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Update existing users who already have a CZU email set\n-- This handles any existing data that should have verified_work_email set\nupdate public.users u\nset verified_work_email = au.email,\n    verified_work_email_at = au.updated_at\nfrom auth.users au\nwhere u.auth_user_id = au.id\n  and au.email is not null\n  and au.email != ''\n  and lower(split_part(au.email, '@', 2)) in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz')\n  and (u.verified_work_email is null or u.verified_work_email != au.email);",

        "contents": "export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n    // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters properly\n    const redirectUrl = new URL(redirectTo, origin);\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n    url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n    url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  } else {\n    // User needs to verify email, preserve next parameter\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Properly encode the next parameter\n      url.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n    }\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "# Force log out if the user has been inactive longer than the specified duration.\n# inactivity_timeout = \"8h\"\n\n# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/before_user_created_hook\"\n\n# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nauth_token = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)\"\n\n# Multi-factor-authentication is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n[auth.mfa]\n# Control how many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.\nmax_enrolled_factors = 10\n\n# Control MFA via App Authenticator (TOTP)\n[auth.mfa.totp]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\n\n# Configure MFA via Phone Messaging\n[auth.mfa.phone]\nenroll_enabled = false\nverify_enabled = false\notp_length = 8\ntemplate = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Configure MFA via WebAuthn\n# [auth.mfa.web_authn]\n# enroll_enabled = true\n# verify_enabled = true\n\n# Use an external OAuth provider. The full list of providers are: &#96;apple&#96;, &#96;azure&#96;, &#96;bitbucket&#96;,\n# &#96;discord&#96;, &#96;facebook&#96;, &#96;github&#96;, &#96;gitlab&#96;, &#96;google&#96;, &#96;keycloak&#96;, &#96;linkedin_oidc&#96;, &#96;notion&#96;, &#96;twitch&#96;,\n# &#96;twitter&#96;, &#96;x&#96;, &#96;slack&#96;, &#96;spotify&#96;, &#96;workos&#96;, &#96;zoom&#96;.\n[auth.external.apple]\nenabled = false\nclient_id = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your OAuth provider secret to git.         "contents": "-- References the new users table instead of auth.users\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\n\n-- Create trigger function to populate public.users on auth.users creation\n-- Extracts Google OAuth data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data and auth.users.email\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_auth_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_google_email text;\n  v_google_full_name text;\n  v_google_profile_picture text;\n  v_raw_meta_data jsonb;\nbegin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          {
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "Update [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):",

            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "All verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:",
            "lineNumber": 215

          {
            "text": "- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id",

          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "This approach:",

            "lineNumber": 229

          {
            "text": "The project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:",

        "contents": "refresh_token_reuse_interval = 10\n# Allow/disallow new user signups to your project.\nenable_signup = true\n# Allow/disallow anonymous sign-ins to your project.\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false\n# Allow/disallow testing manual linking of accounts\n# Required for linking email identities to OAuth accounts\nenable_manual_linking = true\n# Passwords shorter than this value will be rejected as weak. Minimum 6, recommended 8 or more.\nminimum_password_length = 6\n# Passwords that do not meet the following requirements will be rejected as weak. Supported values\n# are: &#96;letters_digits&#96;, &#96;lower_upper_letters_digits&#96;, &#96;lower_upper_letters_digits_symbols&#96;\npassword_requirements = \"\"\n\n[auth.rate_limit]\n# Number of emails that can be sent per hour. Requires auth.email.smtp to be enabled.\nemail_sent = 2\n# Number of SMS messages that can be sent per hour. Requires auth.sms to be enabled.\nsms_sent = 30\n# Number of anonymous sign-ins that can be made per hour per IP address. Requires enable_anonymous_sign_ins = true.\nanonymous_users = 30\n# Number of sessions that can be refreshed in a 5 minute interval per IP address.\ntoken_refresh = 150\n# Number of sign up and sign-in requests that can be made in a 5 minute interval per IP address (excludes anonymous users).\nsign_in_sign_ups = 30\n# Number of OTP / Magic link verifications that can be made in a 5 minute interval per IP address.\ntoken_verifications = 30\n# Number of Web3 logins that can be made in a 5 minute interval per IP address.\nweb3 = 30\n\n# Configure one of the supported captcha providers: &#96;hcaptcha&#96;, &#96;turnstile&#96;.\n# [auth.captcha]\n# enabled = true\n# provider = \"hcaptcha\"\n# secret = \"\"\n\n[auth.email]\n# Allow/disallow new user signups via email to your project.\n# Disabled to restrict signups to Google OAuth only\nenable_signup = false\n# If enabled, a user will be required to confirm any email change on both the old, and new email\n# addresses. If disabled, only the new email is required to confirm.\ndouble_confirm_changes = false\n# If enabled, users need to confirm their email address before signing in.\nenable_confirmations = true\n# If enabled, users will need to reauthenticate or have logged in recently to change their password.",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to next parameter or default page\n      const redirectTo = next ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n      router.push(redirectTo);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, next, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Get search params once\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  // Respect the next parameter if provided, otherwise use default logged in page\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(next ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"absolute top-6 right-6 md:top-10 md:right-10\"&gt;\n        &lt;LogoutButton /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm next={next} /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser\n;\n;\n}",

        },
        "contents": "  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Determine which email to use: prefer new.email, fall back to email_change if email didn't change\n  -- When email_change is verified, Supabase typically:\n  -- 1. Sets email_change to the new email (temporary)\n  -- 2. Verifies OTP\n  -- 3. Moves email_change to email and clears email_change\n  -- So we need to check both fields\n  \n  -- Check if email changed\n  if old.email is distinct from new.email then\n    v_email := new.email;\n  -- Check if email_change was cleared (moved to email)\n  elsif old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change and (new.email_change is null or new.email_change = '') then\n    -- email_change was cleared, use the current email\n    v_email := new.email;\n  else\n    -- No relevant change\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and not empty\n  if v_email is null or v_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Extract domain from email\n  v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\n  \n  -- Only update verified_work_email if domain is a CZU domain\n  if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Update verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at\n  -- This happens after OTP verification succeeds, so the email is verified\n  -- Only update if the email is different from what's already stored (or not set)\n  update public.users\n  set verified_work_email = v_email,\n      verified_work_email_at = now()\n  where id = v_user_id\n    and (verified_work_email is null or verified_work_email != v_email);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Architecture Overview",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "flowchart TD",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "text": "        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        G --&gt; E",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "        L --&gt; M",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2890523672103882

{\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n    // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters properly\n    const redirectUrl = new URL(redirectTo, origin);\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n    url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n    url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  } else {\n    // User needs to verify email, preserve next parameter\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Properly encode the next parameter\n      url.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n    }\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  // Treat errors as \"no identity\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const emailIdentityCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasEmailIdentity(supabase),\n    \"hasEmailIdentity\",\n  );\n  if (!emailIdentityCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Treat errors as \"no profile\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const linkedProfileCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasLinkedProfile(supabase),\n    \"hasLinkedProfile\",\n  );\n  if (!linkedProfileCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Strip all query parameters (e.g., from email verification or QR code)\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Strip hash as well\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to set verified work email when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\n-- Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios\ndrop trigger if exists set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger\nafter update of email, email_change on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (\n  (old.email is distinct from new.email) or \n  (old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change)\n)\nexecute function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change();\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA UPDATE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Update existing users who already have a CZU email set\n-- This handles any existing data that should have verified_work_email set\nupdate public.users u\nset verified_work_email = au.email,\n    verified_work_email_at = au.updated_at\nfrom auth.users au\nwhere u.auth_user_id = au.id\n  and au.email is not null\n  and au.email != ''\n  and lower(split_part(au.email, '@', 2)) in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz')\n  and (u.verified_work_email is null or u.verified_work_email != au.email);",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Get search params once\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  // Respect the next parameter if provided, otherwise use default logged in page\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(next ??         "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const persisted = loadPersistedState();\n\n    // Validate persisted state - if on OTP step but no email, reset to email step\n    if (persisted.step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; (!persisted.email || !persisted.email.includes(\"@\"))) {\n      setStep(\"email\");\n      setEmail(\"\");\n      clearPersistedState();\n      setIsHydrated(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Restore persisted state if valid\n    if (persisted.email &amp;&amp; persisted.email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      setEmail(persisted.email);\n    }\n    if (persisted.step === \"email\" || persisted.step === \"otp\") {\n      setStep(persisted.step);\n    }\n\n    setIsHydrated(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  /**\n   * Persists email changes to sessionStorage\n   * Only saves when we have a valid email address and after hydration\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Don't persist until after hydration to avoid hydration mismatches\n    if (!isHydrated) return;\n\n    if (email &amp;&amp; email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      savePersistedState({ step, email });\n    } else if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; !email) {\n      // If on OTP step but no email, clear invalid state\n      clearPersistedState();\n    }\n  }, [email, step, isHydrated]);\n\n  /**\n   * Auto-submits the form when OTP code reaches the expected length\n   * This handles paste events and manual entry\n   * Prevents re-submission of the same OTP code after a failed verification\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n    const isOtpComplete = trimmedOtp.length === OTP_LENGTH;\n    const isNewOtp = trimmedOtp !== lastSubmittedOtp;\n\n    if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; isOtpComplete &amp;&amp; !isLoading &amp;&amp; isNewOtp) {\n      verifyOTP();\n    }\n  }, [otpCode, step, isLoading, lastSubmittedOtp, verifyOTP]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Card&gt;\n      &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96;         "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity: { provider: string }) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use.         "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to next parameter or default page\n      const redirectTo = next ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n      router.push(redirectTo);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, next, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @param supabaseClient - Supabase client to use. Must be provided to use existing client.\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(\n  supabaseClient: SupabaseClient\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabaseClient.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (authError || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Query profiles directly - RLS policy ensures user can only see their own profile\n  // The RLS policy checks: user_id in (select id from public.users where auth_user_id = auth.uid())\n  // This is more reliable than nested selects with RLS\n  const { data: profiles, error: queryError } = await supabaseClient\n    .from(\"profiles\")\n    .select(\"id\")\n    .limit(1);\n\n  // Return false if query failed or no profiles found\n  if (queryError || !profiles) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if at least one profile exists\n  return Array.isArray(profiles) &amp;&amp; profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an error URL with the given error message\n */\nexport function createErrorUrl(request: NextRequest, errorMessage: string): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n    // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters properly\n    const redirectUrl = new URL(redirectTo, origin);\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n    url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n    url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  } else {\n    // User needs to verify email, preserve next parameter\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Properly encode the next parameter\n      url.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n    }\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n}",
