        },
        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser\n;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  hasEmailIdentity,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"No code provided\"));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n (\n          &lt;form onSubmit={handleVerifyOTP} className=\"flex flex-col gap-4\"&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"otp\"&gt;OTP Code&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"otp\"\n                type=\"text\"\n                placeholder={&#96;Enter ${OTP_LENGTH}-digit code&#96;}\n                value={otpCode}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; {\n                  const newValue = e.target.value.replace(/\\D/g, \"\").slice(0, OTP_LENGTH);\n                  setOtpCode(newValue);\n                  // Clear lastSubmittedOtp when user starts typing a new code\n                  if (lastSubmittedOtp !== null &amp;&amp; newValue !== lastSubmittedOtp) {\n                    setLastSubmittedOtp(null);\n                  }\n                }}\n                onPaste={(e) =&gt; {\n                  e.preventDefault();\n                  const pastedText = e.clipboardData.getData(\"text\").replace(/\\D/g, \"\").slice(0, OTP_LENGTH);\n                  setOtpCode(pastedText);\n                  // Clear lastSubmittedOtp when user pastes a new code\n                  if (lastSubmittedOtp !== null &amp;&amp; pastedText !== lastSubmittedOtp) {\n                    setLastSubmittedOtp(null);\n                  }\n                }}\n                disabled={isLoading}\n                required\n                autoFocus\n                maxLength={OTP_LENGTH}\n              /&gt;\n              &lt;p className=\"text-xs text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n                Check your email for the verification code\n              &lt;/p&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"flex flex-col gap-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Button type=\"submit\" disabled={isLoading} className=\"w-full\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute, DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile, redirectWithCookies } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Safely executes an async check function, catching any errors\n * and treating them as a failed check to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n * @param checkFn - The async function to execute\n * @param checkName - Name of the check for logging purposes\n * @returns Object with ok boolean and optional error\n */\nasync function safeCheck(\n  checkFn: () =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;,\n  checkName: string,\n): Promise&lt;{ ok: boolean; error?: Error }&gt; {\n  try {\n    const result = await checkFn();\n    return { ok: result };\n  } catch (error) {\n    const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\n    console.error(&#96;Error in ${checkName}:&#96;, err);\n    return { ok: false, error: err };\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

          }
        },
        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

        "contents": "import { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  hasEmailIdentity,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"No code provided\"));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser\n;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Creates a success redirect URL\n * @param request - The NextRequest object\n * @param next - Optional next parameter to redirect to after success\n * @returns URL object for redirect\n */\nexport function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n\n  if (next) {\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, request.nextUrl.origin);\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters and hash properly\n      const redirectUrl = new URL(validatedNext, request.nextUrl.origin);\n      url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n      url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n      url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n      return url;\n    }\n  }\n\n  url.pathname = DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n  url.search = \"\"; // Clear any existing search params\n  url.hash = \"\"; // Clear any existing hash\n  return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Determine which email to use: prefer new.email, fall back to email_change if email didn't change\n  -- When email_change is verified, Supabase typically:\n  -- 1. Sets email_change to the new email (temporary)\n  -- 2. Verifies OTP\n  -- 3. Moves email_change to email and clears email_change\n  -- So we need to check both fields\n  \n  -- Check if email changed\n  if old.email is distinct from new.email then\n    v_email := new.email;\n  -- Check if email_change was cleared (moved to email)\n  elsif old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change and (new.email_change is null or new.email_change = '') then\n    -- email_change was cleared, use the current email\n    v_email := new.email;\n  else\n    -- No relevant change\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and not empty\n  if v_email is null or v_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Extract domain from email\n  v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\n  \n  -- Only update verified_work_email if domain is a CZU domain\n  if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Update verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at\n  -- This happens after OTP verification succeeds, so the email is verified\n  -- Only update if the email is different from what's already stored (or not set)\n  update public.users\n  set verified_work_email = v_email,\n      verified_work_email_at = now()\n  where id = v_user_id\n    and (verified_work_email is null or verified_work_email != v_email);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const persisted = loadPersistedState();\n\n    // Validate persisted state - if on OTP step but no email, reset to email step\n    if (persisted.step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; (!persisted.email || !persisted.email.includes(\"@\"))) {\n      setStep(\"email\");\n      setEmail(\"\");\n      clearPersistedState();\n      setIsHydrated(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Restore persisted state if valid\n    if (persisted.email &amp;&amp; persisted.email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      setEmail(persisted.email);\n    }\n    if (persisted.step === \"email\" || persisted.step === \"otp\") {\n      setStep(persisted.step);\n    }\n\n    setIsHydrated(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  /**\n   * Persists email changes to sessionStorage\n   * Only saves when we have a valid email address and after hydration\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt;         "contents": "  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to set verified work email when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\n-- Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios\ndrop trigger if exists set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger\nafter update of email, email_change on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (\n  (old.email is distinct from new.email) or \n  (old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change)\n)\nexecute function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change();\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA UPDATE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Update existing users who already have a CZU email set\n-- This handles any existing data that should have verified_work_email set\nupdate public.users u\nset verified_work_email = au.email,\n    verified_work_email_at = au.updated_at\nfrom auth.users au\nwhere u.auth_user_id = au.id\n  and au.email is not null\n  and au.email != ''\n  and lower(split_part(au.email, '@', 2)) in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz')\n  and (u.verified_work_email is null or u.verified_work_email != au.email);",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function         "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.         "contents": "/**\n * Form component for email verification via OTP\n * Allows users to link an email identity to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(\"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isHydrated, setIsHydrated] = useState(false);\n  const [lastSubmittedOtp, setLastSubmittedOtp] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n;\n}",

## Summary of Changes

### 1. **Added OTP expiration constant**
   - Added `OTP_EXPIRY_SECONDS = 3600` to `/lib/constants/auth.ts`

### 2. **Created helper functions for OTP state management**
   - Added to `/lib/auth-helpers.ts`:
     - `getPendingOtpState()` - Retrieves pending OTP state from user metadata with expiration check
     - `setPendingOtpState()` - Stores OTP state in user metadata
     - `clearPendingOtpState()` - Clears OTP state from user metadata

### 3. **Refactored verify-email-form component**
   - Removed `sessionStorage` usage
   - Uses user metadata for persistent, cross-device OTP state
   - Checks expiration (3600 seconds) when loading state
   - Refreshes session after verification
   - Redirects based on profile status:
     - If profile exists → redirects to protected page (or `next` parameter)
     - If no profile → redirects to pending-approval page

### 4. **Updated verify-email page**
   - Checks for pending OTP state on load
   - Passes initial email to form component if pending state exists

### 5. **Updated confirm-email-change route**
   - Clears pending OTP state after verification
   - Refreshes session
   - Redirects based on profile status (same logic as form)

## Features

- Cross-device persistence: OTP state stored in user metadata, accessible from any device
- Automatic expiration: OTP expires after 3600 seconds (1 hour)
- Session refresh: Token refreshed after verification
- Smart redirects: Redirects to pending-approval if no profile, otherwise to protected area
- No new database fields: Uses existing user metadata

The implementation is complete and ready to use. Users can start verification on one device and complete it on another, and the OTP will expire after 1 hour for security.

        "contents": "import { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  hasEmailIdentity,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (!code) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"No code provided\"));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({\n  next,\n  initialEmail,\n}: {\n  next?: string;\n  initialEmail?: string;\n}) {\nconst verifyOTP = async () =&gt; {\n\n      \n      if (hasProfile) {\n        // User has profile, redirect to protected area\n        const redirectTo = next ?? \"/protected\";\n        router.push(redirectTo);\n        router.refresh();\n      } else {\n        // User verified email but no profile, redirect to pending approval\n        router.push(\"/auth/pending-approval\");\n        router.refresh();\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, next, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads pending OTP state from user metadata after component mounts\n   * Checks for server-side persisted OTP state (cross-device support)\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const loadPendingOtp = async () =&gt; {\n      try {\n        const pendingState = await getPendingOtpState(supabase);\n        \n        if (pendingState?.email) {\n          // Restore OTP step if valid pending state exists\n          setEmail(pendingState.email);\n          setStep(\"otp\");\n        } else if (initialEmail) {\n          // Use initial email from server if provided\n          setEmail(initialEmail);\n          setStep(\"otp\");\n        }\n      } catch (err) {\n        // Ignore errors loading pending state\n        console.error(\"Failed to load pending OTP state:\", err);\n      } finally {\n        setIsHydrated(true);\n      }\n    };\n\n    loadPendingOtp();\n  }, [supabase, initialEmail]);\n\n  /**\n   * Updates pending OTP state in metadata when email changes\n   * Only updates after hydration and when moving to OTP step\n   */\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./app/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts",
        "range": {

            "line": 90,
            "column": 1
          }

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n  clearPendingOtpState,\n  hasLinkedProfile,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Clear pending OTP state after successful verification\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({\n  next,\n  initialEmail,\n}: {\n  next?: string;\n  initialEmail?: string;\n}) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Clear pending OTP state from metadata\n      await clearPendingOtpState(supabase);\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      const { data: { session }, error: refreshError } = await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      if (refreshError) {\n        setError(\"Failed to refresh session. Please try again.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Check if user has linked profile to determine redirect destination\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      \n      if (hasProfile) {\n        // User has profile, redirect to protected area\n        const redirectTo = next ?? \"/protected\";\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile, getPendingOtpState } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Get search params once\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  // Respect the next parameter if provided, otherwise use default logged in page\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(next ??         "contents": "/**\n * Creates a success redirect URL\n * @param request - The NextRequest object\n * @param next - Optional next parameter to redirect to after success\n * @returns URL object for redirect\n */\nexport function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n  const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n\n  if (next) {\n    // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n    const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, request.nextUrl.origin);\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters and hash properly\n      const redirectUrl = new URL(validatedNext, request.nextUrl.origin);\n      url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n      url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n      url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n      return url;\n    }\n  }\n\n  url.pathname = DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n  url.search = \"\"; // Clear any existing search params\n  url.hash = \"\"; // Clear any existing hash\n  return url;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  // Get user's email address\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const userEmail = user?.email || \"your email\";\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({\n  next,\n  initialEmail,\n}: {\n  next?: string;\n  initialEmail?: string;\n}) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n        {\n          emailRedirectTo: redirectUrl,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Store OTP state in user metadata for cross-device persistence\n      await setPendingOtpState(supabase, email.trim());\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export function createSuccessUrl(request: NextRequest, next?: string | null): URL {\n\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates a redirect response with cookies copied from supabaseResponse\n * Preserves all cookie options (httpOnly, secure, sameSite, etc.)\n */\nexport function redirectWithCookies(\n  url: URL,\n  supabaseResponse: NextResponse,\n): NextResponse {\n  const redirectResponse = NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  const setCookieHeaders = supabaseResponse.headers.getSetCookie();\n  setCookieHeaders.forEach((cookieHeader) =&gt; {\n    redirectResponse.headers.append(\"Set-Cookie\", cookieHeader);\n  });\n  return redirectResponse;\n}\n\n/**\n * Interface for pending OTP state stored in user metadata\n */\ninterface PendingOtpState {\n  email: string\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable. Always create a new one on each request.\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n            request.cookies.set(name, value),\n          );\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n          );\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  // Do not run code between createServerClient and\n  // supabase.auth.getClaims(). A simple mistake could make it very hard to debug\n  // issues with users being randomly logged out.\n\n  // IMPORTANT: If you remove getClaims() and you use server-side rendering\n  // with the Supabase client, your users may be randomly logged out.\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n  const user = data?.claims;\n\n  const pathname = request.nextUrl.pathname;\n  // Include full path with query parameters and hash for next parameter\n  const fullPath = pathname + request.nextUrl.search + request.nextUrl.hash;\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname))\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({\n  next,\n  initialEmail,\n}: {\n  next?: string;\n  initialEmail?: string;\n}) {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n;\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { isValidWorkEmailDomain, OTP_LENGTH } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport {\n  hasLinkedProfile,\n  getPendingOtpState,\n  setPendingOtpState,\n  clearPendingOtpState,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Form component for email verification via OTP\n * Allows users to link an email identity to their Google OAuth account\n * OTP state is persisted server-side in user metadata for cross-device support\n */\nexport function VerifyEmailForm({\n  next,\n  initialEmail,\n}: {\n  next?: string;\n  initialEmail?: string;\n}) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(initialEmail || \"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(initialEmail ? \"otp\" : \"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isHydrated, setIsHydrated] = useState(false);\n  const [lastSubmittedOtp, setLastSubmittedOtp] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "/**\n * Validates that a redirect URL is safe (same-origin or relative path)\n * Prevents open redirect vulnerabilities by rejecting external URLs\n * @param url - The URL to validate (can be relative path or absolute URL)\n * @param origin - The origin of the current request\n * @returns The validated safe path, or null if validation fails\n */\nexport function validateRedirectUrl(url: string | null, origin: string): string | null {\n  if (!url) {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Reject empty strings\n  if (url.trim() === \"\") {\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  // Allow relative paths (starting with /)\n  if (url.startsWith(\"/\")) {\n    // Ensure it doesn't contain protocol-relative URLs or other schemes\n    if (url.includes(\"://\") || url.startsWith(\"//\") || url.startsWith(\"javascript:\")) {\n      return null;\n    }\n    return url;\n  }\n\n  // For absolute URLs, check if they're same-origin\n  try {\n    const urlObj = new URL(url, origin);\n    const originObj = new URL(origin);\n\n    // Reject if protocol doesn't match (http vs https)\n    if (urlObj.protocol !== originObj.protocol) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Reject if host doesn't match\n    if (urlObj.host !== originObj.host) {\n      return null;\n    }\n\n    // Return the pathname + search + hash (same-origin URL is safe)\n    return urlObj.pathname + urlObj.search + urlObj.hash;\n  } catch {\n    // Invalid URL format\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // The url which will be included in the email. This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const callbackUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        // Properly encode the next parameter - it may contain query parameters itself\n        // Use encodeURIComponent to ensure it's properly encoded\n        callbackUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: callbackUrl.toString(),\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute, DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile, redirectWithCookies } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Safely executes an async check function, catching any errors\n * and treating them as a failed check to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n * @param checkFn - The async function to execute\n * @param checkName - Name of the check for logging purposes\n * @returns Object with ok boolean and optional error\n */\nasync function safeCheck(\n  checkFn: () =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;,\n  checkName: string,\n): Promise&lt;{ ok: boolean; error?: Error }&gt; {\n  try {\n    const result = await checkFn();\n    return { ok: result };\n  } catch (error) {\n    const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));\n    console.error(&#96;Error in ${checkName}:&#96;, err);\n    return { ok: false, error: err };\n  }\n}\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({\n  next,\n  initialEmail,\n}: {\n  next?: string;\n  initialEmail?: string;\n}) {\n() =&gt; {\n\n  }, [supabase, initialEmail]);\n\n  /**\n   * Updates pending OTP state in metadata when email changes\n   * Only updates after hydration and when moving to OTP step\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Don't update until after hydration to avoid hydration mismatches\n    if (!isHydrated) return;\n\n    // Only update metadata when moving to OTP step with valid email\n    if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; email &amp;&amp; email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      setPendingOtpState(supabase, email).catch((err) =&gt; {\n        console.error(\"Failed to update pending OTP state:\", err);\n      });\n    } else if (step === \"email\" &amp;&amp; email) {\n      // Clear pending state if user goes back to email step\n      clearPendingOtpState(supabase).catch((err) =&gt; {\n        console.error(\"Failed to clear pending OTP state:\", err);\n      });\n    }\n  }, [email, step, isHydrated, supabase]);\n\n  /**\n   * Auto-submits the form when OTP code reaches the expected length\n   * This handles paste events and manual entry\n   * Prevents re-submission of the same OTP code after a failed verification\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n    const isOtpComplete = trimmedOtp.length === OTP_LENGTH;\n    const isNewOtp = trimmedOtp !== lastSubmittedOtp;\n\n    if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; isOtpComplete &amp;&amp; !isLoading &amp;&amp; isNewOtp)\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { InfoIcon } from \"lucide-react\";\nimport { FetchDataSteps } from \"@/components/tutorial/fetch-data-steps\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\n\nasync function UserDetails() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  if (error || !data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return JSON.stringify(data.claims, null, 2);\n}\n\nexport default function ProtectedPage() {\n  return\n}",

## Summary of Fix

The issue was that after OTP verification, the session refresh wasn't properly updating cookies and the redirect wasn't working. Changes:

1. **Changed redirect method**: Replaced `router.push()` with `window.location.href` to force a full page reload, ensuring:
   - Session cookies are sent to the server
   - Middleware can check the updated session server-side
   - Proper redirect based on session state

2. **Simplified redirect logic**: Removed client-side profile check after refresh. Now:
   - Clear pending OTP state
   - Refresh session (updates cookies with new email identity)
   - Redirect to `/protected` (or `next` parameter)
   - Let middleware handle routing (it checks session and profile status server-side)

3. **Removed unused router**: Removed the `useRouter` import and variable since we're using `window.location.href`.

After OTP verification, the session refreshes, cookies update, and the user is redirected. The middleware checks the session server-side and routes to pending-approval if no profile exists, or allows access to protected routes if a profile exists.
